protocol.eval: mean true pass rate over all 36 tasks

part_c_flat_pool.design: 36 independent single-skill tasks, initial logits 2.0-0.28s (p from ~0.55 to ~2e-4), same protocol as part B
part_c_flat_pool.prediction_preregistered: no compounding => myopic lp_closed stops losing; var_tilted advantage vanishes or reverses

part_d_lookahead_flat.design: horizon-h lookahead LP on flat pool, cached per-task utility (recomputed only for the updated task); utility = cumulative delta-p over h virtual expected updates via the closed-form single-task ODE E[dtheta]=lr*g(p)*p*(e0-q); gamma=1, 10 seeds
part_d_lookahead_flat.mechanism_prediction: if one-step LP loses via ignored within-task option value, AUC rises in h toward/past var_tilted

part_e_posterior.design: deployed-machinery test: decayed-Beta Thompson teacher (teachers.py Teacher base, default decay) with utility (1-ptilde)^alpha * u_N(ptilde), alpha in {0,1,2,3}; alpha=0 is the deployed AdvMassTeacher; both pools, 10 seeds, gamma=1 equivalent

part_f_stochastic_lookahead.design: utility = mean cumulative delta-p over M=32 exact stochastic virtual futures of h groups (K~Bin(N,p); exact MaxRL single-task update: correct logit += lr(1-K/N), failure actions -= lr*count/N; sum w = 0 kills the -q drift), cached per task, flat pool, 10 seeds
part_f_stochastic_lookahead.hypothesis: stochasticity is the residual: stoch_h200 closes the remaining -.017 to var_tilted
